title: 1D Observer Form [A(v),B(v),C(v),F(v),H(v)]
text: Implement gain-scheduled state-space controller in observer form depending on one scheduling parameter, 3 inputs, 1 output; {A-matrix(v)} sets a -matrix of the state-space implementation, {B-matrix(v)} sets the b -matrix of the state-space implementation, {C-matrix(v)} sets the c -matrix of the state-space implementation, {F-matrix(v)} sets the f -matrix of the state-space implementation, {H-matrix(v)} sets the h -matrix of the state-space implementation, {Scheduling variable breakpoints} sets the breakpoints for scheduling and {Initial state, x_initial} sets the initial states. Values come from the instance.

params.name: A-matrix(v)
params.values: A -matrix of the state-space implementation A (default) | array

params.values: B -matrix of the state-space implementation B (default) | array

params.name: C-matrix(v)
params.values: C -matrix of the state-space implementation C (default) | array

params.name: F-matrix(v)
params.values: F -matrix of the state-space implementation F (default) | array

params.values: H -matrix of the state-space implementation H (default) | array

params.values: Breakpoints for scheduling variable v_vec (default) | vector
